title: ExpTracker
tagline: Scan your grocery receipts. See where you could spend less.

status.label: Pre-development
status.description: Architecture and research complete. Implementation not yet started.

sections.heading: What is this?
sections.body:
ExpTracker is a mobile app for Singapore residents to scan grocery receipts, track personal spending, and instantly see whether the items they bought are available for less at a different supermarket chain.

It is not a generic expense tracker or a budgeting app. It is built around one specific insight: the same grocery item can differ by 20–40% in price across Singapore chains, and most people have no easy way to know this at the time they shop.

items.title: Price opacity at the point of purchase
items.body: Singapore has no mandatory retail price registry and no MRP law. NTUC FairPrice, Sheng Siong, Cold Storage, Giant, Don Don Donki, and Indian provision shops all stock many of the same items — at different prices — with no single place to compare them.

items.title: Post-purchase regret with no actionable output
items.body: People occasionally notice a price difference after the fact, but there is no lightweight way to record the observation, aggregate it with others, and turn it into a changed shopping habit.

items.title: Manual expense tracking is abandoned quickly
items.body: Existing trackers require manual data entry. People start, forget, and stop. The app must earn its keep at the moment of least friction: right after checkout, receipt in hand.

sections.heading: The Solution
sections.intro: One flow solves all three problems:

steps.label: Scan
steps.description: Point your camera at any grocery receipt. OCR extracts every line item automatically.

steps.label: Confirm
steps.description: Review the extracted items, correct any errors, then save. Your personal expense history is stored privately, linked only to your account.

steps.label: Compare
steps.description: The app checks confirmed item prices against the crowdsourced pool and surfaces differences across chains. No judgemental framing — only "available for less at X."

steps.label: Contribute
steps.description: Your confirmed prices — stripped of all personal identifiers — are added to the shared pool, making comparison more accurate for everyone.

primary.label: Primary user
primary.description: Singapore resident who does weekly or fortnightly grocery shopping, shops at 1–2 chains regularly, and wants to stretch their grocery budget without spending time on manual research.

sections.heading: Key Features — MVP
rows: Camera capture + OCR (PaddleOCR), English and Chinese receipts
User confirms or edits extracted items before saving
Privately stored bill and item history by date and retailer
Chain-level comparison for confirmed items against the shared pool
Anonymised price data contributed by all users, no personal linkage
Covers NTUC FairPrice, Sheng Siong, Cold Storage, Giant, Don Don Donki, Indian provision shops

sections.heading: What Makes It Different
rows: No grocery focus, no price comparison
Manual entry, no OCR, no comparison
Not linked to your actual purchases
sections.callout: No product combines post-purchase receipt scanning with crowdsourced, purchase-linked price comparison for Singapore grocery chains. That is the gap ExpTracker fills.

items.rest: are stored privately, linked to your account. You control them.
contains only: item name, price, unit, retailer chain, month/year. No user ID, no bill ID, no full date. Outside PDPA personal data scope by design.
are deleted immediately after OCR is confirmed. Never stored permanently.
The comparison pool is a shared utility, not a monetisation asset.

sections.heading: Revenue Model
sections.note: Freemium from day 1 — not free now, paid later. Avoids feature regression perception.

tiers.name: Free
features: Up to 10 bill scans per month
